summary: Backend API regression passed (health + inquiries + validation + idempotency + Mongo persistence). Frontend core one-page flows are mostly working with successful inquiry submission/retry, but two UI behavior issues were observed.

ui_bugs.issue: When consent is unchecked, browser-native checkbox validation tooltip appears (English) and prevents app-level German error message from rendering.
Intermittent failure to open about/content dialogs immediately after closing another dialog (close animation/race timing).

integration_issues.issue: Console warning seen during reduced-motion checks: container position warning from motion/useScroll integration.

action_items: Unify consent validation UX: show localized app error for unchecked consent instead of browser-native tooltip.
Debounce or guard modal state transitions so header dialog buttons work reliably right after close animations.
Review Framer useScroll/reduced-motion warning source and eliminate console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: No public inquiry read endpoint is exposed (good).
Inquiry duplicate request_id idempotency works and does not create extra Mongo document (verified).
Backend currently allows only GET/POST via CORS and correctly validates payload constraints with Pydantic.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Cleanup executed for test-created inquiry records and smoke record id a12c9e7a-4c8a-4b16-9a10-5da4f3e170b8.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop load, sections, anchors, parallax, reduced-motion behavior, service-card->detail->inquiry material mapping, inquiry submit success, network-intercept retry, legal dialogs, and responsive overflow checks were executed. Some Playwright steps failed when chaining immediate dialog-close->next-open actions; rerun with short delay after close. Mobile overflow checks passed at 390/360/768.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: Consent path uses native HTML required checkbox behavior before custom error rendering, causing non-localized tooltip and bypassing in-app error component. RCA-2: Dialog state transitions (Radix close animation + immediate next action) can race with subsequent nav button clicks, causing intermittent missed open events. Mitigation: add small post-close state guard/debounce or wait for dialog unmount before next trigger.
